en.title: From Reweighting to Rewriting: Unlocking Intervention Effects in Training Data Attribution
en.hook: Unlock precise model behavior control by moving beyond sample reweighting to direct data rewriting in TDA.
key_takeaways: Addresses limitations in traditional Training Data Attribution (TDA)
Highlights the power of data rewriting over simple reweighting
Analyzes intervention effects of influential training samples
